FIIS NET BUYERS AT ₹5,866.78 CRORE ON 18 NOV

On 18 November 2026, foreign institutional investors (FIIs) were net buyers of ₹5,866.78 crore in the cash market, while domestic institutional investors (DIIs) were net sellers of ₹3,159.90 crore.

November so far (3 sessions): FIIs +14,926.84 crore, DIIs -6,482.02 crore.

In derivatives, FIIs held 32.5% of their index futures positions long (net -70,670 contracts, -5,547 from the previous session). Net index calls: -1,96,496; net index puts: +3,74,199 contracts.
